summary: One-frame event of esv::camp::ChestSystem: the camp chest assigned to a user changed. Created on a new event entity by bg3.exe+0x2BEAF80 (AllocRaw 0x10) from bg3.exe+0x2BE9510 (macOS: esv::camp::ChestSystem::Update writes it), which writes the user id and the chest entity. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

fields.name: User
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2BEAF80 writes DAT_14617ceac (the default UserID global) at +0; writer bg3.exe+0x2BE9510 line ~900 `*puVar16 = *puVar23` (a 4-byte user id).

fields.name: Chest
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle) at +8; writer line ~901 `*(longlong *)(puVar16 + 2) = lVar14` (the entity assigned to the user; name from the component name).

open_questions: That +8 is the chest (and not the user's character) follows from the component name only.
